$comment: Vision RULE 20.4.2/20.4.4/20.4.5. Declared, configurable backup placement, retention and residency. No value here is hard-coded in the backup subsystem.

sites.description: Primary datacentre backup store, separate from the database's own data directory.
Isolated protected copy (RULE 20.4.4). Append-only: artefacts are written once and never overwritten or pruned by retention.
Off-region replica for geographic placement and residency (RULE 20.4.5).
